show.description: Love Gamble is a drama mini-series that follows the unlikely connection between a wealthy nightclub owner and a struggling young woman. The story begins when Litika, a homeless woman, rescues an expensive watch belonging to Nishant Singhaniya, a powerful club owner. Grateful and intrigued, Nishant brings Litika into his world, offering her a job and a place to stay.
